facts: Merchant Center is not available to retailers in Iran.
Businesses from a restricted country are not supported even when targeting non-restricted countries.
A participating merchant publishes discovery metadata at /.well-known/ucp.
The profile declares shopping services, transport, endpoint, schema and supported capabilities.
CreateCart uses POST /carts and returns a continue_url to the merchant site.
The cart capability is designed for transferring a cart from Google surfaces to the merchant.
Native checkout uses dedicated authenticated checkout-session endpoints.
A normal WooCommerce checkout page is not by itself a UCP native-checkout integration.
Content API for Shopping sunset on 2026-08-18; Merchant API is the current API path.
UCP account integration support exists in Merchant API with limited access.
Current Google help says UCP checkout guidance applies to eligible products in the United States, Canada, and Australia and to participating merchants and partners.
UCP checkout remains available to select merchants; eligibility and participation must not be inferred.

policy: Do not create a Merchant Center account using a fake country, address or business identity.
Do not publish /.well-known/ucp until a real UCP service endpoint and permitted integration exist.
Do not claim UCP checkout/cart/order support merely because WooCommerce has cart and checkout pages.
Keep product IDs, variants, price, stock, shipping, returns, cart and order contracts ready for future authorized integration.
